snippet: Aug 25, 2026 · The persistence of WAL mode means that applications can be converted to using SQLite in WAL mode without making any changes to the application itself. One has merely to run " PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; " on the database file (s) using the command-line shell or other utility, then restart the application.
